long_biography.plain_text:
After studying business administration at Portland State University and completing an MBA at Santa Clara University, Fahad Mohammed Saleh Al-Athel returned to Saudi Arabia. His first venture, Saudi FAL, traded construction materials before becoming an agent for an international construction company. That early experience in trade and business development became the foundation for a wider privately controlled enterprise.

Al-Athel subsequently established companies in fields ranging from industrial equipment, pipes and control systems to hospitals, property, telecommunications and aviation. He held an overwhelming majority stake in FAL Arabia Holding, combining ownership with responsibilities as founder, chairman and chief executive. Beyond the group, he also served as a director and investor in Saudi and international commercial businesses.
long_biography.html:
After studying business administration at Portland State University and completing an MBA at Santa Clara University, Fahad Mohammed Saleh Al-Athel returned to Saudi Arabia. His first venture, Saudi FAL, traded construction materials before becoming an agent for an international construction company. That early experience in trade and business development became the foundation for a wider privately controlled enterprise.

Al-Athel subsequently established companies in fields ranging from industrial equipment, pipes and control systems to hospitals, property, telecommunications and aviation. He held an overwhelming majority stake in FAL Arabia Holding, combining ownership with responsibilities as founder, chairman and chief executive. Beyond the group, he also served as a director and investor in Saudi and international commercial businesses.
